expectations.text: Rejects cumulative lifetime spend/revenue as the value column

expectations.text: Explains the reason: cumulative revenue tracks tenure, and high-revenue low-margin customers poison the model
expectations.evidence: Lifetime spend tracks *tenure* ... a value-based lookalike trained on it will happily scale low-margin, high-frequency discount shoppers because they rack up totals

expectations.text: Recommends margin or predicted LTV as the value column instead
expectations.evidence: Use **margin or predicted LTV** for both the cutoff and the uploaded value.

expectations.text: Flags the $0 gift-recipient rows: the value column must contain positive values only

expectations.text: Requires refunded amounts to be excluded from the value computation

expectations.text: Notes that value-based audiences on Meta require a separate terms acceptance
